messages:
Sara L: Heads up — DeployBot just refused the canary publish for redwood/app:canary-2026-03-21-abc123, provenance check failed with a digest mismatch :grimacing:
DeployBot: publish blocked — provenance.digest != manifest.digest (expected sha256:3a1f..., got sha256:9b8e...) — see /runbooks/provenance-ops (automated)
Priya K: ugh, was this pushed from CI or local? any clue which step wrote the wrong manifest?
Sara L: CI pipeline says publish step succeeded, but deploybot log shows `manifest annotated with buildid=2026-03-21T15:12Z` and the attestation digest doesn't match the manifested layers
Mike H: I pulled the image locally, `docker inspect` shows ImageID sha256:3a1f... while ECR stores manifest digest sha256:9b8e... mismatch between image vs signed manifest
Carlos M: Could be a transient mirror/replication issue across regions — but this is the staging canary, we should hold instead of forcing through
Priya K: Agreed. What's the rollback/pin plan? Do we pin to last known-good digest or rebuild? We should avoid a rebuild unless necessary
Sara L: Proposal: pin the canary tag to the last signed digest (sha256:3a1f...), create a canary-retag job and have deploybot re-verify. Manual retag command for reference:
```
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/app --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:3a1f... 
# then put-image with tag canary-2026-03-21-pinned
```
DeployBot: advisory — manual put-image is allowed when provenance verification fails. Operator must add a comment with `release:manual-pin` and link to CI build
Mike H: I'll take the retag and push. Doing it now, will run verification afterwards. ETA ~10m. @Carlos M can you watch deploybot logs?
Carlos M: watching :eyes:
Ops Bot: scheduled change window note — hold Canary rollout until 2026-03-21T16:00Z to allow manual pin and verification. Notifying product.
Priya K: Also update release notes: "Canary held due to provenance digest verification; manual pin applied to avoid disrupting consumers." I'll add a line in the changelog
Mike H: Retag done: `redwood/app:canary-2026-03-21-pinned -> sha256:3a1f...` Ran deploybot re-verify, now passing provenance check :thumbsup:
DeployBot: publish allowed — provenance check passed for tag canary-2026-03-21-pinned (verified by buildid 2026-03-21T15:12Z)
Sara L: Nice. Follow-ups: (1) add a quick CI assert to compare image manifest digest vs attestation before pushing, (2) ops to run a small audit across recent pushes to see if any other tags drifted
Carlos M: I'll open a short postmortem thread and assign action items. Also adding a short note to the deploy runbook about manual-pin flow and required comment format
Priya K: Thanks everyone. If anything else pops up, ping #incidents but we can close this thread once docs are updated.
Mike H: closing — will drop the retag command and logs into the postmortem thread shortly :white_check_mark:
